title: W3Schools: List Append and Pop
description: Given a list `lst` and an item `item_to_add`, append `item_to_add` to the end of the list, then remove and discard the first element (index 0). Return the modified list.
starter_code:
def list_ops(lst: list[int], item_to_add: int) -> list[int]:
    pass
solution:
def list_ops(lst: list[int], item_to_add: int) -> list[int]:
    res = list(lst)
    res.append(item_to_add)
    res.pop(0)
    return res
explanation: Appends to end and removes front element (FIFO queue step) in O(N) time.
